The openmod wiki page "Power plant portfolios" lists it under "List of availability of power plants in Spain and Portugal". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power plant inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
